name: C5/C9 Daily Sales Dashboard

metrics.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(FAMOUNT),2) AS value FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
metrics.title: Order Value (Last 30d)

metrics.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(FQTY_ORIGIN),1) AS volume FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
metrics.title: Order Volume (t)

metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
metrics.title: Order Lines

metrics.sql: SELECT DATE(PLANDATE) AS day, ROUND(SUM(FQTY_ORIGIN),1) AS qty, ROUND(SUM(FAMOUNT),0) AS amount FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY DATE(PLANDATE) ORDER BY day
metrics.title: Daily Order Value & Volume

metrics.sql: SELECT FNAME AS material, ROUND(SUM(FAMOUNT),0) AS amount FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY FNAME ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 8
metrics.title: Top Materials by Value

metrics.sql: SELECT partner_name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(FAMOUNT),0) AS amount FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY partner_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 8
metrics.title: Top Customers by Value

metrics.sql: SELECT FNAME AS material, ROUND(SUM(FAMOUNT),0) AS amount FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY FNAME ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 6
metrics.title: Value Share by Material

metrics.sql: SELECT DATE(PLANDATE) AS order_date, FNAME AS material, partner_name AS customer, FQTY_ORIGIN AS qty, ROUND(FAMOUNT,0) AS amount FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 14 DAY ORDER BY PLANDATE DESC LIMIT 100
metrics.title: Recent Order Detail

insights.body: The last 30 days of order value are dominated by a single large booking on Aug 28 (≈59% of the week's value). Daily trend is spiky, not smooth — worth confirming whether this is a genuine bulk contract or a data-loading artifact.
insights.title: Heavy Aug 28 concentration

insights.body: Newest order record is 2026-08-31; no orders ingested for Sep 1–3. If upstream activity exists, the ERP-to-warehouse sync may be delayed.
insights.title: Data lag since Aug 31

insights.body: Daily Order Value & Volume moved 85.7% down vs the previous period (locked server-side from the live datasource at build time).
insights.title: 📉 Daily Order Value & Volume
